Command '['mysql', '--defaults-file=/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/.claude/database/ds_my_new_prod.cnf', '-N', '-B', '-e', "
SELECT td.code, td.name, td.version,
       (SELECT MAX(ti.submit_time) FROM t_ds_task_instance ti WHERE ti.task_code = td.code) AS last_submit
FROM t_ds_task_definition td
WHERE td.flag = 1
  AND td.task_params LIKE '%dws_ad_request_metric_d%'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM t_ds_workflow_task_relation r
    JOIN t_ds_workflow_definition w
      ON w.code = r.workflow_definition_code AND w.release_state = 1
    WHERE r.post_task_code = td.code
  )
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_ds_task_instance ti WHERE ti.task_code = td.code)
ORDER BY last_submit DESC
LIMIT 5
"]' returned non-zero exit status 1.
